heroes.name: Pulse Tech
heroes.pickerBlurb: Flat damage that builds into burn on high rolls. Low HP, high damage ceiling.

heroes.name: Strike Unit
heroes.pickerBlurb: Pure DPS. Damage on every roll, the highest sustained output in the squad. No utility.

heroes.name: Spite Guard
heroes.pickerBlurb: Taunts fire onto itself, shields allies, and strips enemy shields. Tanks and pressures at once.

heroes.name: Avalanche Suit
heroes.pickerBlurb: Freezes enemy dice to skip incoming hits and heals the whole squad. Control plus sustain.

abilities.name: Permafrost Aegis
abilities.eff: 9 dmg, all 8 shield, -2 roll, 2t, freeze all (1 reveal skip)

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.eff: 15 dmg, all 14 shield, -3 roll, 2t, freeze all (1 reveal skip)

heroes.name: Splice Medic
heroes.pickerBlurb: Single-target and party heals, burn cleanse, and revives.

heroes.name: Field Engineer
heroes.pickerBlurb: A Protocol battery that shields and heals low, then turns to AoE damage on high rolls.

heroes.name: Ghost Operative
heroes.pickerBlurb: A single-target assassin: cloaks past big hits, weakens one enemy, then bursts it down.

heroes.name: Signal Breaker
heroes.pickerBlurb: Spreads debuffs across the whole enemy tray, softening every incoming hit at once.
